name: noctograph
description: Local-first flight recorder for AI coding agents.

scripts.build:binaries: pnpm --filter agent-blackbox build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-binaries',{recursive:true,force:true})" && pnpm exec esbuild packages/cli/dist/pkg-entry.js --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node24 --define:import.meta.url=undefined --outfile=packages/cli/dist/agent-blackbox.cjs --external:node-pty && pnpm exec pkg packages/cli/dist/agent-blackbox.cjs --out-path dist-binaries --targets node24-linux-x64,node24-macos-x64,node24-win-x64 --public-packages "*"
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test
